I submitted the pizza order, and httpbin's response page echoed back the values I entered. I left that page open in its tab.

- **Customer name:** Ada Lovelace
- **Telephone:** 555-0100
- **Email:** ada@example.com
- **Size:** large
- **Toppings:** bacon and extra cheese
- **Delivery time:** 19:45
- **Delivery instructions:** "Ring twice"

The form's time picker didn't accept typed input, so I set the delivery time field's value to 19:45 directly in the page. The submitted data shows it went through.

tool_input.command: S=$(agent-browser session id --scope worktree --prefix task); agent-browser --session $S open https://httpbin.org/forms/post; agent-browser --session $S snapshot -i

A="agent-browser --session task-e986687aa37d"; $A fill @e2 "Ada Lovelace"; $A fill @e3 555-0100; $A fill @e4 ada@example.com; $A check @e7; $A check @e8; $A check @e9; $A fill @e12 "Ring twice"; $A click @e14; $A type @e14 "07"; $A type @e15 "45"; $A type @e16 "PM"; $A snapshot -i
